name: npc_chumpz-bartender
customDialogue:
Big Chain polishes a glass and grins under his bucket hat.
Welcome to the Banana Bar! First round is on the house.
The band plays when the sun goes down. The chumpz dance until it comes back up.
Try the banana rum. Or don’t. Nobody remembers either way.

name: npc_chumpz-fisher
customDialogue:
Pengu adjusts his goggles. Shh. The big one bites at noon.
The bait shop sells worms and books. Same shelf. Do not mix them up.
Catch a fish, trade it at the bar. That is how we pay around here.

name: npc_chumpz-dealer
customDialogue:
Peely lowers his shades. Roll the bones, friend.
Snake eyes buys the next round. House rules: no peeling bananas at the table.
I wear mine on my head. Keeps the luck in.

name: npc_chumpz-villager
customDialogue:
Banana Band taps the banana in his headband. Emergency snack.
The lagoon is warm, the bar is open, the hammocks are free.
If you see a ripe one on the big sign, tell me. It has been yellow for years.

name: interiorEntrance_chz_tiki_lounge
promptText: Press O to Enter the Tiki Lounge

interiorDefinition.title: The Tiki Lounge
interiorDefinition.description: The bar's back room: bamboo and thatch, the aquarium, the jukebox, the dance floor under the mirror ball.

name: interiorEntrance_chz_jungle_casino
promptText: Press O to Enter the Jungle Casino

interiorDefinition.title: The Jungle Casino
interiorDefinition.description: Felt dice tables, the giant banana wheel, palm trunks for pillars, gold banana chandeliers.

name: interiorEntrance_chz_bait_shop
promptText: Press O to Enter the Bait Shop

interiorDefinition.title: The Bait Shop
interiorDefinition.description: The back room: rods, glowing lures in the bait tanks, trophy fish, nets, the frosted cooler.

name: interiorEntrance_chz_ship_cabin
promptText: Press O to Enter the Ship Cabin

interiorDefinition.title: The Ship Cabin
interiorDefinition.description: The captain's cabin under the stern: windows full of turquoise sea, the chart table, the treasure map.

hotspots.description: Big Chain caught every fish in it himself and named them all after bands. The orange one is called Banana Band, obviously.
It only plays island songs and one heavy metal track nobody admits to choosing.
Sixteen slots, eight bananas. Land on the gold and the house buys a round for the whole bar.
Peely runs the tables. The dice are honest; Peely, mostly.
You blow on the dice for luck and let them fly. They tumble across the green felt... one... and one. Snake eyes! The whole casino groans and cheers at the same time.
Pengu makes these by hand and swears the fish can see them from the reef.
Every fish on the wall is a story, and every story gets a little bigger each time it is told.
The cooler breathes frost on your face. Inside: one bucket of wriggling bait, labelled PENGU in very big letters. Now run it down to him!
An island, a dotted path and an X. One corner of the map is torn off; whoever has the missing piece knows where the path really starts.
Peely's corner fits the map like a key. The dotted path does not start at the beach at all: it starts at the banana well, and runs to an X on the east beach.

spotConfig.label: Look up at the banana sign
spotConfig.text: One banana on the giant sign is not like the others. It is gold, real gold, hanging under the big one by a rope. Somebody up there is very proud of it.

spotConfig.label: Look down into the water
spotConfig.text: Down through the clear water, past the end of the pier: a little rowboat sitting on the sand, half full of it. A crab has moved in and put up a tiny flag.

spotConfig.label: Feed the smoke fire

requires.hint: The smokehouse fire is banked for the night. Come back when the smoke is up.

spotConfig.text: You throw a handful of wet palm leaves on the fire. The smoke goes up in three fat puffs, the old Chumpz signal for: party at the bar tonight.

spotConfig.label: Ring the last-call bell

requires.hint: The bell over the bar is only rung at night.

spotConfig.text: DING. Every ape in the bar groans, then laughs, then orders one more. Last call at the Chumpz bar has never once been the last.

spotConfig.label: Listen to the lily pads

requires.hint: The lily pads only sing after dark.

spotConfig.text: At night the frogs on the lily pads sing in parts: low, high, and one very small frog who is always a beat late. They finish with a splash.

spotConfig.label: Look in the drying nets
spotConfig.text: Tangled in the drying net: a glass bottle with a note inside. It says: "To whoever finds this: the fish were THIS big." There is a drawing.

spotConfig.label: Look up the palm
spotConfig.text: At the very top of the tallest palm in Chumpz, one coconut has a face painted on it. It is smiling at you. It has always been smiling at you.

spotConfig.label: Look in the barrel
spotConfig.text: In the open barrel, on a pile of banana peels, a tiny ant is fast asleep. It sits up, yawns, and whispers something.

spotConfig.label: Read the welcome sign
spotConfig.text: WELCOME TO CHUMPZ. No shoes, no shirt, no problem. The bananas are free, the fish are fresh and the dice are only a little bit loaded. The Chumpz.

name: npc_chumpz-racer
customDialogue:
The Racer revs an engine that is not there. CHUMPZ RACING, number seventy-seven!
Fastest ape on the island. Ask anyone. Ask the crabs.
The boardwalk is the best track in the world. No corners. Well. Two corners.

name: npc_chumpz-barnacle
customDialogue:
Barnacle squints at you from under her captain's cap. Bait is fresh, books are used, both smell of fish.
I have run this shop since before the bar had a roof. Nobody remembers the bar without a roof. That is how long.
The tide waits for nobody. Neither do I.

spotConfig.label: Cast and wait
holdLines: The float bobs on the water...
spotConfig.text: You haul in a fat silver snapper. It looks at you like you owe it money.

spotConfig.label: Pick up the ukulele
spotConfig.text: The ukulele, half buried in the sand behind the bar. Two strings are still in tune, which is a Chumpz record.

spotConfig.label: Pick up the bongos
spotConfig.text: The bongos, hiding behind the fish rack. They smell of snapper now. That is just how they sound.

spotConfig.label: Pick up the maracas
spotConfig.text: Two maracas rolling about on the boardwalk. Chk-chk. The fish below look interested.

spotConfig.label: Set up the instruments
spotConfig.text: Ukulele on its stand, bongos on the stool, maracas in the bucket. The stage is ready to party.

spotConfig.label: Start the race
spotConfig.startText: Three, two, one, GO! Thirty-two seconds, flag to flag. Hold R to run!
spotConfig.failText: Too slow! The Racer is already sipping a banana shake. Back to the start flag and try again.
spotConfig.text: You pass the last flag with seconds to spare. Somewhere behind you, the Racer whistles.

spotConfig.label: Run the bait to Pengu
spotConfig.startText: Go! Eight seconds to the end of the long pier. Hold R to run!
spotConfig.failText: The bait got bored. Back to the Bait Shop and try again.
spotConfig.text: You skid to a stop beside Pengu with the bucket. Not one worm spilled. Well. One.

spotConfig.label: Hang your snapper
spotConfig.text: You hang your snapper with the others. Twelve fish swing in the smoke like a very slow wind chime.

spotConfig.label: Feed the fire
holdLines: Damp palm leaves on the coals...
The smoke thickens and turns sweet.
spotConfig.text: Sweet smoke rolls out of every gap in the smokehouse. Somewhere, Big Chain sniffs the air and smiles.

spotConfig.label: Mend the net
spotConfig.text: Knot, loop, pull. The west quay net has one hole fewer than it had.

spotConfig.label: Mend the net
spotConfig.text: Knot, loop, pull. A crab watches you mend the east quay net, judging.

spotConfig.label: Mend the net
spotConfig.text: The net heaped on the long pier had a hole you could sail a rowboat through. Not any more.

spotConfig.label: Look for the sunglasses
spotConfig.text: Not here. Just a banana peel and a lot of footprints. Big Chain says the band ended the night doing the conga down to the fish racks.

spotConfig.label: Look for the sunglasses
spotConfig.text: Not here either. But something shiny is scuttling off towards the west huts. Sideways.

spotConfig.label: Talk to the crab
spotConfig.text: A crab is wearing the sunglasses, and it looks fantastic. After a short negotiation and one banana, it hands them over.

spotConfig.label: Make a wish
spotConfig.text: Two lucky shells drop into the banana well. Plip. Plop. Somewhere deep down, something hums back.

spotConfig.label: Hammer down the loose board
spotConfig.text: Bang, bang, bang. The loose board on the west pier lies flat and quiet.

spotConfig.label: Hammer down the loose board
spotConfig.text: A board on the long west pier was lifting at one end. Not any more.

spotConfig.label: Hammer down the loose board
spotConfig.text: Pengu's pier had a loose board right where Pengu stands. Of course it did.

spotConfig.label: Hammer down the loose board
spotConfig.text: The east pier's loose board is down. A gull applauds. Probably.

spotConfig.label: Tie off the bow line
spotConfig.text: Twice round the post and pulled tight. The bow stops bumping the pier.

spotConfig.label: Tie off the stern line
spotConfig.text: The stern line is tight. The red sailboat sits still for the first time all week.

spotConfig.label: Haul up the sail
spotConfig.text: The sail climbs the mast and fills with wind: Chumpz Cove yellow and white, with a red pennant on top.

spotConfig.label: Push the rowboat into the water
spotConfig.text: With a grunt and a shove the rowboat slides off the sand. You hop in and row her home along the shore. Your arms will remember this.

spotConfig.label: Pick the bunch
spotConfig.text: A heavy bunch, yellow with just a freckle of brown. Perfect for rum.

spotConfig.label: Pick the bunch
spotConfig.text: This bunch is so ripe it practically jumps into your arms.

spotConfig.label: Pick the bunch
spotConfig.text: The last bunch. A parrot in the palm above looks betrayed.

spotConfig.label: Count the fish
spotConfig.text: Fourteen fish on the west rack, counting the ones in the basket underneath. One of them winks.

spotConfig.label: Count the fish
spotConfig.text: Sixteen fish on the east rack, all facing the same way. Suspicious.

spotConfig.label: Count the fish
spotConfig.text: Twelve fish in the smokehouse, smoking quietly. Forty-two altogether.

spotConfig.label: Light the tiki torch
spotConfig.text: Whoosh. The west end of the boardwalk glows.

spotConfig.label: Light the tiki torch
spotConfig.text: The torch by the west pier flares orange.

spotConfig.label: Light the tiki torch
spotConfig.text: The middle torch lights up the gate from behind.

spotConfig.label: Light the tiki torch
spotConfig.text: Another torch blazes. The fish below gather to look.

spotConfig.label: Light the tiki torch
spotConfig.text: The last torch roars up at the east end. The whole boardwalk glows.

spotConfig.label: Cast for the big one
holdLines: The float vanishes. Something big has the bait.
It is pulling you down the pier!
spotConfig.text: With one last heave the big one flops onto the pier: a giant golden snapper, longer than you are tall. Pengu drops his hat.

spotConfig.label: Follow the map path
spotConfig.startText: The map says: from the banana well, walk where the red stakes stand. Off you go.
spotConfig.failText: You wandered off the map. Back to the banana well and start again.
spotConfig.text: The last stake leans towards a red X on the sand.

spotConfig.label: Dig at the X
spotConfig.text: An old sea chest, and inside it, wrapped in a flag: the Golden Coconut, the Chumpz Cove party trophy, lost since before the bar had a roof.

spotConfig.label: Light the bonfire
spotConfig.text: The bonfire roars up. As if it heard, the sun starts sliding into the sea, and every torch on the boardwalk answers.

skill.title: Light the bonfire
skill.startText: Strike when the marker is in the gold. Three good strikes light it.

spotConfig.label: Dance with the cove
holdLines: Banana Band counts it in: one, two, one-two-three...
Pengu does the robot. Nobody asked.
Peely spins Barnacle round. Barnacle allows it.
The Racer tries to race the conga line. The conga line wins.
spotConfig.text: The whole cove dances round the fire until the stars come out. Then it dances some more.

riddles.q: What gets wetter the more it dries?
riddles.why: Ask any ape at the Banana Bar: the bar towel never gets a day off.

riddles.q: How many bananas can you eat on an empty stomach?
a: One. After that it isn't empty
riddles.why: After the first banana your stomach isn't empty any more.

riddles.q: Pengu caught 3 fish. Two fathers and two sons each ate a whole fish, and none were left over. How?
a: One fish was cut in half
They were a grandfather, his son and his grandson
Pengu went back for a fourth
One of them only ate the bones
riddles.why: The grandfather and the father are two fathers; the father and the grandson are two sons. Three apes, three fish.

riddles.q: I'm full of holes, yet I still hold water. What am I?
riddles.why: A net lets the water through. A sponge keeps it.

riddles.q: Peely rolls two dice. Which total comes up most often?
riddles.why: Six ways make 7 (1 and 6, 2 and 5, 3 and 4, and back again). Only one way makes 2 or 12.

riddleAnswer.text: Carved inside the well's rim: a crane standing over the waves.

game.title: Jungle Run
game.text: Through the banana jungle and up onto the Banana Bar
